paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文在相关工作部分将目标论文[23]列为使用mmWave进行语音窃听的代表性工作之一，但未展开描述其具体贡献或能力。

evidences.evidence_quote: Authors in [17] used mmWave to acquire high-quality voice from user's vocal vibrations from near-throat region. [23] proposed a speech eavesdropping approach by leveraging the piezoelectric films and mmWave signals.
evidences.evidence_context: Authors in [17] used mmWave to acquire high-quality voice from user's vocal vibrations from near-throat region. [23] proposed a speech eavesdropping approach by leveraging the piezoelectric films and mmWave signals. [24] proposed a remote and through-wall screen attack that used mmWave to remotely collect information from LCD screens.
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang et al., "mmPhone: Acoustic eavesdropping on loudspeakers via mmWave-characterized piezoelectric effect," in Proc. IEEE Conf. Comput. Commun., 2022, pp. 820–829.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 证据中[23]对应的引用条目是'C. Wang et al., "mmPhone: Acoustic eavesdropping on loudspeakers via mmWave-characterized piezoelectric effect,"'，但目标论文是'Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration'，两者标题不同。该引用条目错误地关联了不同的论文，因此属于假阳性。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 引用论文将目标论文[23]误作为另一篇mmPhone论文引用，实际目标论文未在正文中被直接引用。
